allGames.title: All games
allGames.intro: Every ticket on sale, ranked by average return per €1.
allGames.note: Return per €1 removes big prizes already claimed; the amber line shows how much lower that is than on paper. "Ends" is the last day of sale announced by ONCE. "Low data" means too few claims seen to estimate sales reliably.

game.historyNote: Adjusted return only drops below its on-paper value when big prizes are claimed. Share sold firms up as more claims are seen; early values rest on few. Shaded gaps are periods without data.
game.noHistory: Not enough history to chart yet.
